title: MCP adds request-time tools. It does not replace the index.

hotspots.label: Where to set it up
hotspots.detail: Deployments created on or after September 22, 2026 use Connectors to set up catalog-backed MCP integrations. A custom or unlisted remote MCP server uses the separate Connect remote MCP servers path.

hotspots.label: One app, two entries
hotspots.detail: One application can have more than one catalog entry: one entry might index content while another provides MCP tools.

hotspots.label: A documented hybrid
hotspots.detail: NetSuite MCP gives real-time access with each user's own NetSuite credentials and role, and depends on the native NetSuite connector being set up.

hotspots.label: When partner guidance says go live
hotspots.detail: Consider custom actions or MCP for querying live data. For large structured data lakes, use a custom action or MCP server to query the data.

footnote: Date-sensitive: the Connectors setup path applies to deployments created on or after 2026-09-22. Re-verified 2026-09-26.
